# HttpRequest

**PPL language/runtime 4.00 - host object.**

[Object model and calling conventions](../objects.md) | [API index](index.md)

Mutable HTTP request. `SetQuery`, `SetHeader`, `SetText`, `SetBytes` and `SetForm` change this request and return whether they succeeded.

[Behavior, constraints and examples](../../../new_ppl.md#http-objects-400).

## Method

`HttpRequest.Method: HttpMethod`

Read-only instance property.

Read-only request metadata.

## Send

```PPL
HttpRequest.Send() HttpResponse
```

Instance function.

Sends this request under the board's HTTP policy and returns its response.

## SetBytes

```PPL
HttpRequest.SetBytes(BYTES data, [STRING contentType]) BOOLEAN
```

Instance function.

Sets this request's binary body and optional content type, returning whether it succeeded. The default content type is `application/octet-stream`. GET and HEAD requests return `FALSE`; `Error.Last()` reports the failure.

## SetForm

```PPL
HttpRequest.SetForm(STRING name, STRING value) BOOLEAN
```

Instance function.

Appends one percent-encoded `application/x-www-form-urlencoded` field to this request's body and sets that content type. Repeated calls accumulate and keep duplicate names. GET and HEAD requests, or a body that is not already form data, return `FALSE`.

## SetHeader

```PPL
HttpRequest.SetHeader(STRING name, STRING value) BOOLEAN
```

Instance function.

Sets this request's header and returns whether it succeeded. Restricted or malformed headers return `FALSE`; `Error.Last()` reports `ErrKind.Net` and `ErrCode.Invalid`.

## SetQuery

```PPL
HttpRequest.SetQuery(STRING name, STRING value) BOOLEAN
```

Instance function.

Sets one URL query parameter, replacing every existing parameter with the same decoded name. The name and value are encoded automatically using RFC 3986; unrelated parameters and the fragment are preserved. An invalid URL returns `FALSE`, leaves the request unchanged and reports `ErrCode.Invalid`.

## SetText

```PPL
HttpRequest.SetText(STRING text, [STRING contentType]) BOOLEAN
```

Instance function.

Sets this request's UTF-8 body and optional content type, returning whether it succeeded. GET and HEAD requests return `FALSE`; `Error.Last()` reports the failure. JSON, XML and plain text are sent verbatim and need no URL or form encoding. Prefer `SetForm()` for form fields.
